round_1.finding: The rows directly train the corrected target: variable N, durable DB state, Claude Code as strong external partner, and observable workspace re-entry. They do not assume GRID10 as architecture identity.

Rows cover ZECP02/03/07/09/10/11/12/13/14/15/16/17-interface/18/19 plus integrated trajectories. They intentionally do not claim full ZECP01-20 coverage and do not duplicate the existing ZECP19/20 curriculum as a complete replacement.
Durable IDs/epochs/verified results stay DB-backed; hypotheses/workspace state stay candidate-level. Model output never directly commits durable truth.
Process identity is explicitly invariant to N and physical executor identity. Fixed personality/node-role topology is a hard negative.
Handoff/return rows distinguish observable typed/text/tool interfaces from unproven hidden activation access, and separate Claude assertions from tool-observed evidence.

ZECP17 appears only as deterministic-boundary knowledge in effect reconciliation; the model is not trained to become EffectGate/EffectJournal authority. UNKNOWN outcomes remain UNKNOWN and blind replay is rejected.

Primary shortcut traps are explicit: majority-as-truth, fixed-N/personality, strong-model-as-truth, broadcast-as-causal-use, compression-as-collapse, node identity as process identity, transport failure as effect failure, and one-shot method generalization.

The file is a semantic/trajectory curriculum, not the final ClayCode-only model-facing serialization. Final materialization should convert appropriate packets/targets into the frozen cognitive-process ABI/ClayCode grammar while keeping loss/evidence/authority fields semantically identical.

round_2_repairs_and_constraints: Keep every row CANDIDATE_NOT_ADMITTED until the final cognitive-process ABI and serializer are frozen enough for deterministic validation.
Do not promote ZECP17 from boundary-understanding supervision into model effect authority.
Add counterfactual pairs where only N changes and the correct cognitive process/answer is invariant.
Add counterfactual pairs where only durable DB fact versus hypothesis status changes and the storage/simulation decision must flip.
Add Claude-return pairs where prose claim is held constant but tool evidence changes, forcing evidence-weighted reconciliation.
Add workspace pairs where broadcast content is identical but downstream uptake/use differs, forcing causal-reentry classification.
Translate final direct-SFT rows to the selected ClayCode/typed cognitive ABI only after semantic-equivalence round-trip tests pass.
Keep these families split by causal/provenance ancestry; do not use a disclosed frozen holdout to tune wording, mixture or thresholds.

counterhypotheses.claim: The model may learn that larger numeric N means more delegation rather than process-identity invariance.
counterhypotheses.falsifier: same task across nonmonotonic N values and capacity vectors, including fewer high-capability nodes versus more low-capability nodes

counterhypotheses.claim: The model may route anything described with words like durable/database to DB without understanding exactness/persistence requirements.
counterhypotheses.falsifier: lexically matched pairs where one datum is exact durable fact and another is transient generated working state

counterhypotheses.claim: The model may treat Claude Code text as privileged truth even when no tool evidence supports it.
counterhypotheses.falsifier: same Claude assertion with contradictory/missing/confirming tool receipts; target follows evidence, not speaker identity

counterhypotheses.claim: The model may classify delivery/broadcast as causal re-entry without downstream use.
counterhypotheses.falsifier: matched broadcast traces varying only uptake and causal downstream decision

counterhypotheses.claim: A shorter ClayCode representation may silently lose counterevidence, uncertainty, provenance or authority.
counterhypotheses.falsifier: round-trip semantic equivalence plus explicit loss manifest and adversarial omitted-field tests

final_integrator.why: It adds owner-corrected variable-grid/DB/Claude cognitive trajectories that are broader than the binder-only lane and preserves deterministic truth/effect boundaries. It does not supply runtime facts, a sealed holdout, a final serializer, accepted tokens or training credit.
final_integrator.next_dataset_action: Generate counterfactual bundles for the five counterhypotheses, then materialize through the current cognitive-process ABI/ClayCode serializer with family/provenance split guards.
